#### Blue Whale Watching 2027!

Considered the latest experience: a true marine safari. Great opportunities to see fin whales, humpback whales, pilot whales, manta rays, sea lions, dolphins, and much more.

[Join us](https://loretobaytours.com/ballenaazul/)

## Frequently Asked Questions

 No results. 

## Do I need previous experience to go diving or snorkeling?

 Not necessarily. We offer guided dives for beginners as well as specialized excursions for certified divers. Our instructors will explain the use of the equipment, underwater communication signals, and safety procedures before each dive.  
  
 For snorkeling, you only need to know how to swim and have the desire to explore. 

## What Makes BCS Tours Different from Other Companies?

 We are local operators with more than 28 years of experience and deep roots in Loreto.  
  
 We design and operate our own Keiko vessels, created with a focus on comfort, safety, and sustainability. Every tour is led by certified professionals who are passionate about nature and committed to exceptional service, environmental education, and the conservation of Loreto Bay National Park.  
  
 Here, we do not simply take tourists to the sea…  
  
 We inspire conscious travelers. 

## Do you package fish?

 Yes, we filet and package fish 

## How can I book a tour?

 You can book directly through our website, via WhatsApp, email, or by visiting our offices at the Loreto Marina.  
 We offer secure payment options, private or shared tours, and personalized assistance to help you choose the perfect experience for your adventure.  
  
 “Your adventure begins the moment you decide to discover Loreto with us.” 

## What type of sport fishing do you offer?

 We offer recreational sport fishing focused on species such as marlin, dorado, yellowtail, and tuna, depending on the season. We provide all the necessary equipment, from rods and lures to a live-bait tank and 360° space to fight your catch. We also promote responsible fishing and the “catch & release” practice to help conserve marine populations.
